A discretionary reporter is any individual, not mandated by law, who reports suspected child abuse or neglect.

Who May Report (PC 11166 (g))

“Any other person who has knowledge of or observes a child whom he or she knows or reasonably suspects has been a victim of child abuse or neglect may report the known or suspected instance of child abuse or neglect to an agency specified in Section 11165.9. May report anonymously (PC 11167 (f))

“Persons who may report child abuse pursuant to subdivision (g) of Section 11166 are not required to give their names.” (Discretionary reporters are encouraged, however, to give their names.
